header: Choose how to set up your first till
subheader: The software and the price are the same on all three routes.
lead: The only difference is who enters your articles and who supports you on your first busy morning.
note: €39 per till per month on every route. Setup with us costs nothing extra, and dealers charge for their own work.

paths.title: Set it up yourself
paths.description: You enter articles and prices, and we check your first cashing-up. Suits one branch with one or two tills.

paths.title: Set it up with us
paths.description: One appointment, your article list imported and someone on the phone on your first Saturday. For three or more tills, or if you use scales.

paths.title: Use your own dealer
paths.description: If a dealer already looks after your hardware, you stay with them. We work with 40 dealers in Austria and southern Germany.
